assessment_objectives.objective: instances that require a manual override of current account privileges, to respond to unusual conditions without terminating the current session and establishing a new session as a higher-privileged user, are identified.

the processes and technologies needed to enable a manual override of current account privileges, to respond to unusual conditions without terminating the current session and establishing a new session as a higher-privileged user, are identified.

a capability exists to manually override current account privileges, to respond to unusual conditions without terminating the current session and establishing a new session as a higher-privileged user.
